title: PAH-OMC-020 C_sw first-moment sufficiency boundary
question: Does the existing R-490 Gibbs-state-weighted first-moment bound C_sw=540 by itself imply the L2 generator or N2c/N4 compact-time boundary control needed for the anchored-n temporal passage?
finding: No. An exact reversible two-state family has stationary conductance 2M/(M+1)<2 and Dirichlet energy 4M/(M+1)<4 for a bounded test, while its L2 generator norm squared is 4M and is unbounded. The result is a sufficiency obstruction for the proposed inference from C_sw alone, not an exact PAH counterexample or universal no-go.
decision_reason: This is a bounded route advance because it separates the first-rate Gibbs envelope from the squared-rate or pathwise input actually needed for an L2/Duhamel boundary argument. It preserves every PAH definition and converts the next proof obligation into one source-owned second-moment or Lyapunov contract rather than another finite carrier calculation.
boundary: The PAH-001 functional, original directed rates, labelled Gibbs state, OMC-004 strips, R-490 normalization, external Markov time and j-before-n order remain frozen. The two-state family is an abstract hostile diagnostic only.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-010, R-490 and the PAH-OMC-020 temporal preregistration.
Recompute S_geom=8, N_geom=60 and C_sw=540 from the R-490 certificate.
For every integer M>=1, verify detailed balance for pi(0)=1/(M+1), pi(1)=M/(M+1), c(0,1)=M and c(1,0)=1.
Compute the first conductance moment, Dirichlet energy and L2 generator norm for f=(1,-1), and prove the last quantity is unbounded while the first two remain bounded.
Run independent, hostile and Lean checks, then keep N2c/N4 and R-512 process identification on HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
next_action: Obtain a source-owned PAH estimate of a local second-rate moment C2(A), or an equivalent conditional/pathwise Lyapunov non-explosion bound, and connect it to N2b, N2c/N4 and R-512 minimal-form identification.
revisit_condition: Reopen only when such an estimate is supplied with exact PAH domains and parent hashes, or when an exact PAH-specific contradiction to the required estimate is found. Do not relabel this abstract witness as a PAH no-go.
non_claims: No PAH functional, rate, state, carrier, regulator, time or limit order is changed.
No exact PAH counterexample, universal impossibility theorem or semigroup convergence result is claimed.
No common process, N2b/N2c/N4 closure, R-512 minimal-form selection, infinite-volume dynamics, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
External Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping and is not physical time.
verification_summary: Primary 46/46, non-importing independent 27/27, hostile 13/13 and integrated 26/26 checks pass; Lean 4.32.1 compiles the nine rational declarations. The route remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
